items.name: constellation-designer
items.description: List, show details of, and get recommendations for pre-designed agent councils (Constellations) for structured deliberation. Use this skill to explore and select the right council for a problem before running it with the constitutional-orchestrator.

items.name: constitutional-orchestrator
items.description: Runs a structured, multi-agent deliberation with a named Constellation or a custom list of agents, governed by the Metacanon Constitution. Use to execute a deliberation after a council has been chosen with the constellation-designer skill.

items.name: council-pack-creator
items.description: A utility skill to create and manage reusable
